---
title: "Prevalence filtering of the merged genus table"
output: html_document
params:
  input: "results/amplicon/merged_bacteria.csv"   # output of the merging document
  metadata: "downstream_input/metadata.csv"       # needs a column "Sample"
  threshold: 0.9                                  # a genus must be present in at least this fraction of the samples
  out_dir: "results/amplicon"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r filter}
count <- read.csv(params$input, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
dim(count)
meta <- read.csv(params$metadata)
stopifnot("the metadata needs a column 'Sample'" = "Sample" %in% colnames(meta))
sample_cols <- which(colnames(count) %in% meta$Sample)
head(sample_cols)
identical(colnames(count),meta$Sample)
n <- length(sample_cols)
n
presence <- rowSums(count[, sample_cols] > 0)
prevalence <- presence / n
keep <- prevalence >= params$threshold
filtered <- count[keep,]
dim(filtered)
write.csv(filtered, file.path(params$out_dir, sprintf("merged_bacteria_%d%%_prevalence.csv", round(100 * params$threshold))))
```
